install-powershell.description: Installs PowerShell 7 with Windows’ own WinGet package manager.

install-homebrew.description: Installs the Homebrew package manager for the Mac.

gh-auth-login.description: Signs in to GitHub with the gh tool. By default, you sign in in the browser.

install-claude-code.description: Installs Claude Code with Anthropic’s official install script.

claude-doctor.description: Checks your Claude Code installation and reports any problems.

start-claude.description: Starts Claude Code in the current folder. The first time, it asks you to sign in.

claude-plan-mode.description: Starts Claude Code directly in plan mode.

git-config-name.description: Tells Git your name. The name appears in your checkpoints (commits).

git-config-email.description: Tells Git your email address. Use the same address as on GitHub.

git-config-default-branch.description: Sets the name of the main branch of new projects to main.

set-execution-policy.description: Allows your own user account to run local and signed PowerShell scripts.

get-execution-policy.description: Shows PowerShell’s current execution policy settings.

gh-repo-create.description: Creates a new public repo on GitHub from the current folder and sends (pushes) your checkpoints there.

code-open-folder.description: Opens the current folder in VS Code. The dot means “this folder”.

git-init.description: Starts Git tracking in the current folder.

git-status.description: Shows which files have changed since the last checkpoint.

git-add-all.description: Includes all changes in the next checkpoint.

git-commit.description: Makes a checkpoint (a commit) and attaches a message to it.

git-log.description: Lists your checkpoints briefly, newest first.

git-restore.description: Restores a file to how it was in the latest checkpoint. Unsaved changes are lost.

gh-browse.description: Opens your project’s GitHub page in the browser.

open-file-windows.description: Opens the file in its default program (an HTML file in the browser).

open-file-mac.description: Opens the file in its default program (an HTML file in the browser).
